components.name: Root Combiner
components.info: This object combines two root electrical sources into a single signal. Helpful for stringing together low energy batteries or solar panels to produce higher power output. Can be wired in series, can not be used with any non energy producing electrical components.
tips: Can be combined with other Root Combiners
Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator
A limit of 15 chained Root Combiners is allowed before reaching Max Depth

components.name: Electrical Branch
components.info: This object allows you to branch power off from a main line by a set amount.
tips: Adjustable branch (or split) amount with a minimum of 1
The Branch port is prioritized first when outputting power but is not powered first
Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator

components.name: Blocker
components.info: This object prevents passthrough while power is received through its second input.
tips: Can be used to block the output (prevent discharge) of a battery and allow it to charge
Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator

components.name: Memory Cell
components.info: A 1 bit storage component. SET input will set the value to 1 CLEAR input sets the value to 0. Output will provide connected power if value is 1, Inverted output will provide connected power if value is 0. This is also known as a D-Type Flip Flop.
tips: The only component that allows switched (redirected) output of power
When Reset is powered, the Set port will toggle Output if powered and Inverted Output if not
Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator

components.name: Splitter
components.info: Splits an electrical signal into 3 multiple signals. the amount passed through is equal to the input amount divided by the number of used output slots.
tips: Evenly splits the input power to all connected outputs
Extra power after the split is spread evenly across all connected outputs (left to right)
Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator

components.name: Timer
components.info: A Timer switch, will pass power through for duration.
tips: Defaults to 30 seconds and has a minimum of 0.25 seconds
Can be used as a push switch which auto-resets (with a 1-second timer)

props.name: Duration
props.tip: Enter the duration amount in seconds.

props.name: Show Countdown

components.name: RAND Switch
components.info: This switch will allow passthrough based on a random number. Each time the 'Set' input receives power it will roll true or false to allow passthrough.
tips: When Set is powered, the component has a 50% chance to output power
Useful for circuits requiring randomization
Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator

components.name: Switch
components.info: A simple electric switch.
tips: A simple toggle switch; use the Timer for a push-button style switch
Can be used to block the output of a battery

components.name: OR Switch
components.info: A logic gate that allows electrical passthrough if EITHER input receives power, passthrough amount is the greater of either power source.
tips: A component that accepts one or two powered inputs and outputs the greater power
A minimum requirement of 9 components is required to loop-back power

components.name: AND Switch
components.info: A logic gate that allows electrical passthrough if BOTH inputs receives power, passthrough amount is the greater of either power source.
tips: A component that requires two powered inputs and outputs the greater power

components.name: XOR Switch
components.info: An exclusive-or logic gate that allows electrical passthrough if ONLY ONE input receives power, passthrough amount is whichever single input is active. if BOTH inputs receive power, passthrough will be zero.
tips: A component that accepts one or two powered inputs and will not output power while both inputs are powered
A minimum requirement of 9 components is required to loop-back power

components.name: Counter
components.info: A basic cathode ray tube screen combined with an incremental counter. Can display power received, or can count upwards and allow passthrough when a target is reached.
tips: Has a minimum value of 0 and a maximum value of 999
Can also be used to display the passthrough amount

components.name: Fluid Switch & Pump
components.info: A simple switch that enables fluid to pass through. Can be switched on/off manually or via electricity. Can also pump water upwards to higher entities when powered.
tips: Pump Power is required for the component to pump fluid upwards (overcome gravity)
Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator

components.name: Fluid Combiner
components.info: Combines three separate fluid connections into one connection.
tips: Can be combined with other water sources
Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator

components.name: Fluid Splitter
components.info: Splits a fluid connection into three separate connections.
tips: Evenly splits the input fluid to all connected outputs
A Fluid Switch & Pump is required for fluid to flow upwards (overcome gravity)
Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator

components.name: Sprinkler
components.info: A small sprinkler that sprays water around it. Requires a hose connection to supply it with water.
tips: A Fluid Switch & Pump is required for fluid to flow upwards (overcome gravity)
When the passthrough output is used, the sprinker will consume double the water

components.name: Hopper
components.info: Will suck up any dropped items in its radius while powered
tips: The radius is 1.5 meters
Can only be placed on Large Wood Boxes and Storage Barrels

components.name: Industrial Combiner
components.info: Combines three separate industrial connections into one connection.
tips: Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator

components.name: Industrial Splitter
components.info: Splits an industrial connection into three separate connections.
tips: Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator

components.name: Industrial Conveyor
components.info: Moves an item from one container to another.
tips: Can only see the first 32 containers it encounters before reaching max input
Cannot push or pull items from other conveyors, a Storage Adaptor must be in-between
Can be rotated before placing by pressing R in-game, or by pressing R after placing in the simulator
Requires 1 power to operate and 2 power for aux ports to output
Has 2 aux outputs: Filter Pass and Filter Fail (each output 1 power)

props.tip: Enter the JSON Filter text.

components.name: Industrial Crafter
components.info: Attaches to a workbench to allow automated crafting.
tips: You can place a maximum of two Industrial Crafters on a single workbench

components.name: Storage Adaptor
components.info: Attach to a storage container to allow industrial input/output connections.
tips: Requires 1 input power to enable automatic storage contents sorting in the UI
Most storage containers allow for multiple Storage Adaptors to be attached
Can be rotated by pressing R after placing in the simulator
